title: Waist Circumference
subtitle: How waist circumference supports prevention, early detection, and informed health decisions.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the role of waist circumference as a predictor of metabolic and cardiovascular risk. Population-based studies and clinical guidelines recommend its use alongside other measures. Emerging evidence addresses population-specific thresholds and integration into personalized risk assessment. Limitations mainly relate to measurement variability and applicability in special populations.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
